title: 杰斯·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 整齐深棕头发衬着方正净面，成年发明家保留沉着自信的神情。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Jayce is a strong adult Piltover inventor with neat dark brown hair, a clean-shaven square face, and a composed confident expression. Preserve his blue-white and gold technological costume with a fully covering fitted jacket, opaque trousers, gauntlets, and boots. His large transforming hextech hammer rests head-down on the floor, held calmly by the handle with its core inactive and no cannon configuration.
art_direction.scene: A slightly elevated complete figure, asymmetric curved silhouette, naturally separated hands and a small sunlit ground cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: cobalt, ivory, pale brass, steel-blue shadow; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
